Para identificar a los clientes que nunca han realizado una compra, la consulta SQL necesaria es la siguiente:

```sql
SELECT CompanyName
FROM customer
WHERE CustomerKey NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerKey FROM sales);
```

Para obtener los clientes que realizan compras de forma recurrente (en este caso, definidos como aquellos que han comprado en todos los meses registrados en el sistema) y calcular su promedio de compra mensual, la consulta SQL es la siguiente:

```sql
WITH MesesTotales AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (Year * 100 + MonthNumber)) as TotalMeses
    FROM date
    WHERE DateKey IN (SELECT DISTINCT OrderDateKey FROM sales)
),
ComprasPorClienteMes AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CompanyName,
        d.Year,
        d.MonthNumber,
        SUM(s.SalesAmount) as MontoMensual
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customer c ON s.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
    JOIN date d ON s.OrderDateKey = d.DateKey
    GROUP BY c.CompanyName, d.Year, d.MonthNumber
),
ClientesRecurrentes AS (
    SELECT CompanyName
    FROM ComprasPorClienteMes
    GROUP BY CompanyName
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT TotalMeses FROM MesesTotales)
)
SELECT 
    c.CompanyName,
    AVG(c.MontoMensual) as PromedioMensual
FROM ComprasPorClienteMes c
JOIN ClientesRecurrentes cr ON c.CompanyName = cr.CompanyName
GROUP BY c.CompanyName;
```
